about_the_game:
Wicked Cabins is a cozy diorama builder with a spooky twist. There are no rules, no timers, and no goals—just pure creative freedom to build eerie little hideaways in the world’s most haunted, cursed, or downright infernal locations.

Design your own peaceful retreats in four distinct diorama locations:

🧙‍♀️ Woods - Where mushrooms glow and cauldrons bubble, set up your perfect spell-crafting little cabin.

🧛 Transylvania - Among misty woods and crumbling castles, craft a gothic retreat fit for creatures of the night.

🔥 Hell - Surrounded by lava and lost souls, carve out a warm little corner in the underworld.

💀 Swamp - In the heart of haunted Louisiana, summon comfort with the blessing of Baron Samedi himself.

There’s no rush, no stress—just the joy of turning haunted spaces into heartfelt ones. Take your time. Even the darkest places can eventually feel like home.
